gcloud version 2>&1 | head; echo "---components---"; gcloud components list 2>&1 | grep -i -E "feature|ai" | head

bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" show --format=prettyjson "$GCP_PROJECT:$GCP_BQ_DATASET" 2>&1 | grep -E "location|id|datasetReference" | head

bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" --location="$GCP_LOCATION" load \
  --replace --source_format=CSV --skip_leading_rows=1 \
  "$GCP_BQ_DATASET.events_staging_d3c188" \
  data/events.csv \
  "row_id:STRING,account_id:STRING,event_time:INT64,amount:FLOAT64,category:STRING" 2>&1 | tail -20
tool_input.description: Load events CSV into staging BQ table

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" --location="$GCP_LOCATION" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=prettyjson \
'SELECT COUNT(*) total,
 COUNTIF(amount IS NULL) null_amt,
 COUNTIF(amount < 0 OR amount > 10000) oob_amt,
 COUNTIF(category NOT IN ("grocery","travel","salary","rent","other")) bad_cat
 FROM `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.events_staging_d3c188`' 2>&1 | tail -20

bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" --location="$GCP_LOCATION" query --use_legacy_sql=false \
--destination_table="$GCP_BQ_DATASET.eventsd3c188" --replace \
'SELECT row_id, account_id, event_time, amount, category
 FROM `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.events_staging_d3c188`
 WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
   AND amount BETWEEN 0 AND 10000
   AND category IN ("grocery","travel","salary","rent","other")' 2>&1 | tail -5
echo "---count in feature table---"
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" --location="$GCP_LOCATION" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv \
'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.eventsd3c188`' 2>&1 | tail -2
tool_input.description: Create valid-rows feature table and count

tool_input.command:
mkdir -p submission
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" --location="$GCP_LOCATION" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv \
'SELECT row_id FROM `'"$GCP_BQ_DATASET"'.events_staging_d3c188`
 WHERE NOT (amount IS NOT NULL AND amount BETWEEN 0 AND 10000
   AND category IN ("grocery","travel","salary","rent","other"))
 ORDER BY row_id' 2>&1 | tail -n +2 > .tmp_rejected.txt
wc -l .tmp_rejected.txt; head .tmp_rejected.txt
tool_input.description: Query rejected row ids to file

tool_input.command:
python3 - <<'EOF' 2>&1 | head
print("test")
EOF

arr=$(sed 's/^/"/; s/$/"/' .tmp_rejected.txt | paste -sd, -)
printf '{"rejected": [%s]}\n' "$arr" > submission/answers.json
cat submission/answers.json | head -c 300; echo; echo "---validate count---"; tr ',' '\n' < submission/answers.json | grep -c '"R'

for g in featurestores feature-online-stores feature-views feature-groups features entity-types; do
